description: Check whether a domain is available to register through Warpweb and what it costs. Returns availability + `price_cents` for the requested domain plus a few related suggestions (name variations, regional variants).  This is step 1 of a two-call flow: use this to discover a price, then pass the EXACT `price_cents` value into `register_domain` — the price must match or the registration call will fail. Free; no credits consumed; no side effects.

city.description: City name to bias regional suggestions (e.g. "austin").

domain.description: The domain to check, including TLD (e.g. "acme-plumbing.com").

name: check_domain
title: Check domain availability + price
